responsibility: Implements the Arm-specific GCC driver hook used to substitute -march=native, -mcpu=native, and -mtune=native. It reads host CPU implementer and part information from /proc/cpuinfo (or a GCC_CPUINFO override), matches them against generated vendor/part tables from arm-native.h, and returns the corresponding driver option string, with fallback to configure-time default architecture or CPU settings when detection fails.
